subject: general
question: Oil India Limited, a Central Public Sector Enterprise (CPSE), is a ___________ company.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Navratna**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Oil India Limited** is a Central Public Sector Enterprise (CPSE).
 
• It is classified as a **Navratna** company.
 
• Navratna status is a recognition given by the Government of India to public sector enterprises that have comparative advantages and greater autonomy to compete in the global market.
